entries.title: Ezekiel 19:1
segments: And take up a weeping for the rulers of Israel,

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:2
segments: and say: What [is] your mother? A lioness. She lay down among lions; she multiplied her cubs among young lions.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:3
segments: And she brought up one of her cubs; it became a strong lion and learned to tear the prey. It ate men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:4
segments: The nations also heard of him. He was taken in their pit, and they brought him with chains to the land of Egypt.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:5
segments: And when she saw that she had waited [and] that her hope was lost, she took another of her cubs and made him a strong lion.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:6
segments: And he went up and down among the lions; he became a young lion and learned to tear the prey, [and] ate men.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:7
segments: And he knew his widows, and he laid their cities waste, and the land and its fullness was desolated, from the sound of his roaring.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:8
segments: And the nations set against him on every side from the provinces, and spread their net over him. He was taken in their pit.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:9
segments: And they put him in a cage in chains, and brought him to the king of Babylon. They brought him into hunting nets, so that his voice should never again be heard on the mountains of Israel.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:10
segments: Your mother [is] like a vine in your blood, planted by the waters; she was fruitful and full of branches because of many waters.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:11
segments: And she [had] strong rods for the scepters of those who bore rule, and her stature was exalted among the thick branches; and it was seen in her height, with the multitude of her branches.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:12
segments: But she was plucked up in fury; she was thrown down to the ground, and the east wind dried up her fruit. Her strong rods were broken and withered; the fire burned them up.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:13
segments: And now she [is] planted in the wilderness, in a dry and thirsty ground.

entries.title: Ezekiel 19:14
segments: And fire has gone out from a rod of her branches, [which] has licked up her fruit so that there is no strong rod in her to be a scepter to rule. This is a mourning and [shall be] for a mourning.
